question: Which color and form epithets of the deity receive repeated obeisance in this mantra verse?
premises: The deity is addressed as reddish.
The deity is addressed as smoky.
The deity is addressed as lotus-like and receives repeated obeisance.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the reddish, smoky, lotus-like deity.
plain_english: Obeisance, obeisance to the reddish one, the smoky one, the lotus-like one.
